<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">When Do ITINs Expire?</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">ITINs expire if not used on a federal tax return for three consecutive years. The IRS also deactivates ITINs issued before 2013 on a rolling basis.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">How to Know If Your ITIN Expired</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">The IRS sends Notice CP48 when your ITIN is scheduled to expire. You can also check by attempting to file a tax return.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Renewal Process</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">The renewal process is similar to the original application:</p>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">1. Complete Form W-7</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">2. Check the "Renewal" box</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">3. Include your current ITIN</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">4. Attach identity documents</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">5. Submit to IRS or through a CAA</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Documents Needed for Renewal</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">You must provide current, unexpired identity documents. If your passport has expired since your original application, you need a new one.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Timeline</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">ITIN renewal follows the same 6-11 week processing timeline as new applications.</p>
